weights.cost: divide by 1 (free), 1.5 (low cost, <= $50/month), 3 (higher cost) or 4 (price unknown)
weights.difficulty: divide by (1 + access_rank)^0.3 from the dataset registry (archived 0, reachable 1, ... blocked 6)
weights.input_weight: sport tier (P0 4, P1 2, P2 1) x (1 + log2(1 + markets where the input is a missing PRIMARY slot)) x 1.5 if any of those markets is a core market
weights.not_a_claim: No weight is a predicted accuracy or profit gain. It orders work by breadth, priority sport and data quality only.
weights.partial_credit: a dataset that resolves some but not all outstanding needs of an input earns input_weight x 0.35 x (needs it resolves / needs outstanding)
weights.quality: point-in-time (native/event-time 1.0, coarse 0.7, unavailable/unknown 0.45) x history (>=5 seasons 1.0, 3-4 0.85, <3 or unknown 0.6, forward capture only 0.5)
